description: This file defines the EmailRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide email-related data access methods. It includes methods for retrieving emails based on mailbox folders, deletion/archive status, and a full-text search across email fields. The repository encapsulates various query methods and a custom JPQL query for searching emails.

classes.name: EmailRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for email-related database queries, extending JpaRepository with custom query methods for mailbox folder filtering, statuses, and full-text search.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseAndIsArchivedFalseOrderByReceivedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Finds emails in the inbox folder for a user that are not deleted or archived, ordered by received date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseOrderBySentAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves emails in the sent folder for a user that are not deleted, ordered by sent date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Fetches draft emails for a user that are not deleted, ordered by last updated date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndIsDeletedTrueOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves deleted emails (trash) for a user, ordered by deletion date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndIsArchivedTrueOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Fetches archived emails for a user, ordered by last updated date and creation date descending.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a full-text style search on email subject and body fields for a specific owner, excluding deleted emails, ordered by last update and creation date.

calls: select e from Email e where e.owner = :owner and e.isDeleted = false ...
